overview.description: The GraniteShares YieldBoost RGTI ETF (RGYY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is actively managed seeking current income and the daily 2x leverage of the price performance of Rigetti Computing, Inc. (NASDAQ: RGTI) RGYY was launched on Nov 25, 2025 and is issued by GraniteShares.
